name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
description: Local de pouso do Perseverance (18 fev 2021). Base e abrigo da missão.
descriptionEn: Perseverance landing site (18 Feb 2021). Mission base and shelter.

name: Delta de Jezero
description: Delta em leque formado por um rio que desaguava no antigo lago da cratera; alvo principal de amostras.
descriptionEn: Fan-shaped delta built by a river that flowed into the ancient crater lake; main sampling target.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline

name: Frente do delta (Hawksbill Gap)
description: Base da rampa por onde o Perseverance subiu a frente do delta (sols 437-470). Destino do demo.
descriptionEn: Base of the ramp Perseverance used to climb the delta front (sols 437-470). Demo destination.

name: Enchanted Lake
description: Afloramento na base da escarpa do delta, primeira parada do rover na frente do delta (~sol 415).
descriptionEn: Outcrop at the foot of the delta scarp; the rover's first stop at the delta front (~sol 415).

name: Depósito Three Forks
description: Onde o Perseverance deixou 10 tubos de amostras para uma futura missão de retorno (sols 586-653).
descriptionEn: Where Perseverance left 10 sample tubes for a future return mission (sols 586-653).

name: Neretva Vallis
description: Vale do antigo rio que alimentava o lago de Jezero, entrando pelo oeste.
descriptionEn: Valley of the ancient river that fed Jezero's lake from the west.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline

name: Brecha oeste
description: Onde Neretva Vallis rompe a borda da cratera; paredes íngremes.
descriptionEn: Where Neretva Vallis cuts through the crater rim; steep walls.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline

name: Cratera Belva
description: Cratera de ~1 km no topo do delta que expõe camadas do delta.
descriptionEn: ~1 km crater on the delta top that exposes the delta layers.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline

name: Séítah
description: Unidade com cristas rochosas (olivina) e dunas de areia, a sudoeste do pouso. Explorada pela borda.
descriptionEn: Unit of rocky olivine ridges and sand dunes southwest of the landing site; explored along its edge.
source: Approximate centre; NASA/JPL Perseverance mission reports + CTX

name: Máaz
description: Formação do assoalho da cratera ao redor do pouso: rochas vulcânicas planas, terreno bom para caminhar.
descriptionEn: Crater-floor formation around the landing site: flat volcanic rock, good walking terrain.
source: Approximate label position; NASA/JPL Perseverance mission reports

name: Kodiak
description: Morro testemunho (butte) remanescente do delta, ~2 km a sudoeste da frente do delta.
descriptionEn: Butte left over from the delta, ~2 km southwest of the delta front.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline; identification approximate

name: Borda oeste de Jezero
description: Borda da cratera (45 km de diâmetro), ~600 m acima do assoalho.
descriptionEn: Rim of the 45 km crater, ~600 m above the floor.
source: Digitized on USGS Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic 6 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008); approximate outline + CTX DTM
